title: Backtest Loops
description: Independent expanding-window backtests. Every iteration resets capital and positions; returns are not compounded. Missing iterations may still be training or may have stopped before creating a backtest.

list.name: loop
list.label: Loop
list.query: SELECT loop_context->>'loop_id' AS __value, COALESCE(NULLIF(MAX(loop_context->>'label'), ''), 'Unnamed loop') || ' | ' || to_char(MIN(started_at), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') || ' | ' || (loop_context->>'loop_id') AS __text FROM runs WHERE loop_context IS NOT NULL GROUP BY loop_context->>'loop_id' ORDER BY MIN(started_at) DESC

panels.title: Backtest progress (training stages appear once a backtest starts)

targets.rawSql: SELECT MAX((r.loop_context->>'iterations')::int) AS requested, COUNT(*) AS recorded, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM backtest_metrics m WHERE m.run_id=r.run_id AND m.symbol IS NULL AND m.name='total_return')) AS completed FROM runs r WHERE r.loop_context IS NOT NULL AND r.loop_context->>'loop_id' = ${loop:sqlstring}

panels.title: Iterations — click run, execution, or model for details

targets.rawSql: SELECT (r.loop_context->>'iteration')::int AS iteration, CASE WHEN m.total_return IS NOT NULL THEN 'completed' ELSE 'running / unfinished' END AS state, r.run_id::text, r.config->'training'->>'train_start' AS train_start, r.config->'training'->>'train_end' AS train_end, r.config->'training'->>'validation_start' AS validation_start, r.config->'training'->>'validation_end' AS validation_end, r.config->'data'->>'start' AS backtest_start, r.config->'data'->>'end' AS backtest_end, r.config->'universe'->>'snapshot' AS universe_artifact, r.config->'universe'->>'bucket' AS bucket, r.config->'model'->>'prepared_history' AS prepared_history, r.config->'model'->>'artifact_path' AS artifact, r.loop_context->>'model_id' AS model_id, m.total_return, m.sharpe, m.max_drawdown, m.win_rate, m.num_trades, p.execution_id::text FROM runs r LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE name='total_return') AS total_return, MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE name='sharpe') AS sharpe, MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE name='max_drawdown') AS max_drawdown, MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE name='win_rate') AS win_rate, MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE name='num_trades') AS num_trades FROM backtest_metrics WHERE run_id=r.run_id AND symbol IS NULL) m ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT execution_id FROM backtest_performance WHERE run_id=r.run_id ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1) p ON true WHERE r.loop_context IS NOT NULL AND r.loop_context->>'loop_id' = ${loop:sqlstring} ORDER BY iteration

panels.title: Return and max drawdown by iteration (not compounded)

targets.rawSql: SELECT r.loop_context->>'iteration' AS iteration, MAX(m.value) FILTER (WHERE m.name='total_return') AS total_return, MAX(m.value) FILTER (WHERE m.name='max_drawdown') AS max_drawdown FROM runs r LEFT JOIN backtest_metrics m ON m.run_id=r.run_id AND m.symbol IS NULL WHERE r.loop_context IS NOT NULL AND r.loop_context->>'loop_id' = ${loop:sqlstring} GROUP BY r.loop_context->>'iteration' ORDER BY (r.loop_context->>'iteration')::int

panels.title: Independent equity returns — one series per run, each starting from its own capital

targets.rawSql: SELECT e.timestamp AS time, e.equity / NULLIF((r.config->'backtest'->>'initial_capital')::numeric, 0) - 1 AS value, 'iteration ' || (r.loop_context->>'iteration') || ' | ' || r.run_id::text AS metric FROM runs r JOIN equity_snapshots e ON e.run_id=r.run_id WHERE r.loop_context IS NOT NULL AND r.loop_context->>'loop_id' = ${loop:sqlstring} ORDER BY e.timestamp, metric
